Good morning. Today is Sunday, June 14. This is day 2 of 7 on the Switch approval window. Here is the full picture.

Switch approval — 6 days to gate.

The upload package `ap-2026-06-19-switch-upload` is sitting in the queue, status pending, exactly where we left it. Nothing has moved and nothing should move — that is correct for a Sunday. The gate is June 20. Two fields remain open for ISΛRK to resolve before or at that point: the live beat store URL for Switch, and the preferred publish time on July 18. Both are hard inputs the package cannot go out without. If either is missing on June 20, we miss the upload window.

My ask to ISΛRK: locate the beat store listing URL for Switch and decide on a July 18 publish time this week. Sooner is better — if those two things land before June 20, Nyx can fold them into the package and the approval becomes a clean yes-or-no. If they land day-of, we are rushing.

Standing blockers — unchanged.

`DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` and `DISCORD_INTAKE_CHANNELS` are still unset. Aether and Hermes remain dark. No intake has come in, no booking messages, nothing to triage. The task `t-intake-channels` stays in backlog, blocked on user action. This is not urgent today but it is a persistent blind spot — anything sent to the Discord intake channel right now is invisible to us.

Content hold — confirmed.

Homerun and Virtual Love pre-build content stays on hold. The July 1 video decision for Homerun has not landed. We do not build ahead of that. Virtual Love is conditional on a chorus and mix pass that has not started. No change here.

Nightshade — watch item.

Re-mix ETA is still unknown. September 26 is tentative but that slot will compress fast if Aether does not surface a re-mix ETA soon. Worth flagging to ISΛRK: if the re-mix is not close, we should either get a realistic date or quietly remove Nightshade from Q3 before the calendar hardens. A tentative slot with no ETA is not a plan.

Team hold today.

No new work is generated today. The only live action item in the building is ISΛRK providing the beat store URL and a July 18 publish time. Everything else waits on June 20.
